The '''Black Jungle''' was a jungle that covered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krann]]. Krann orbited four [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] [[Star/Legends|stars]], which continually bathed it in blood-red light so the vegetation of the planet evolved to have ebony leaves which absorbed as much available light as possible.
